integrity: Complete proof, integer-polynomial reconstruction and reproduction script supplied; finite brute force is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No claim of external validation.
scientific_limitations: For P(n,2) and n>=5 only; no claims about interior support gaps or other inner steps. Known alpha(P(n,2)) and the general independent-domination polynomial are prior work. Earlier equivalent minimal-vertex-cover enumeration remains a priority risk.
title: Cardinality enumerator and extremal multiplicities of maximal independent sets in \(P(n,2)\)
